metadata.name: append_event
metadata.description: Append a typed event to the context map event store for later materialization.

event_type.description: One of: corpus_ingested, document_retrieved, entity_referenced, schema_discovered, search_failed, fact_disputed.

payload.description: Fields required by the event_type (see context_map_events.py).

parent_skeleton:

Inserts a structured event into `context_map_events`. The MaterializerRunner
picks it up asynchronously and updates the context map.
